name: Clement of Rome
bio: Clement was bishop of the Church at Rome at the end of the first century, and is counted by tradition among the earliest successors of the apostles there. He is the reputed author of the First Epistle to the Corinthians, a letter written about AD 96 in the name of the Roman Church to urge the Christians of Corinth to restore the presbyters they had deposed.

The Second Epistle to the Corinthians is an early Christian homily that was handed down with the first under his name; its attribution to Clement is traditional only. Both are given here in the English translation of Kirsopp Lake (1912).
